description.value: Giant White Rock is an authorized Giant brand bicycle dealership serving the White Rock and South Surrey area, carrying a full lineup of road, mountain, gravel, and electric bikes. The shop runs a dedicated service department offering tiered tune-up packages, and stocks a broad range of accessories including panniers, racks, fenders, and lights that are useful for touring cyclists. Bikes purchased at Giant White Rock or Giant Langley receive complimentary ongoing service.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 41m; rack at 75m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content from giantwhiterock.com/ca was successfully fetched and is the primary evidence source. The site confirms address as #60 - 16041 24th Avenue, White Rock (not Surrey as in OSM), phone 604-536-3436, and operating status. The service page explicitly details repair policies and e-bike service restrictions, and the accessories catalogue confirms touring-relevant parts are stocked.
concerns: OSM addr:city is 'Surrey' but the website consistently lists the address as 'White Rock' (postal code V3S 9H7). Website value used as primary; discrepancy flagged for review.
OSM name is the generic brand name 'Giant' rather than the branch name 'Giant White Rock' — may reduce discoverability in the directory.
OSM phone field is empty; phone 604-536-3436 sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active full-service Giant dealership with a repair department, touring-relevant accessories, and e-bike service — clearly useful to touring cyclists passing through the White Rock/South Surrey corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: E-bike service is limited to Giant, Liv, and Momentum brands only — worth surfacing for cyclists with other e-bike brands.

Touring parts stocked.detail: Website lists Bags & Panniers, Fenders, Lights, Locks, Racks, and Bottles & Cages under Bike Gear Accessories

E-bike service.detail: Service page states: 'We do not work on any e-bike brands except Giant, Liv and Momentum' — confirming e-bike service is available for those brands
